title: Police Chief
statement: The Oakland Police Department has completed deployment adjustments for high-incident zones in East Oakland, West Oakland, and Downtown. Patrol allocation now aligns with CrimeIndex data — 1.11 in East Oakland, 1.10 in West Oakland, and 1.10 in Downtown. These adjustments direct additional sworn resources to the neighborhoods where call volume and violent-level metrics are highest, while maintaining balanced coverage citywide. The department's operational posture remains focused on reducing response gaps and sustaining public safety outcomes across all districts.

payload.text: OPD has transmitted the departmental patrol deployment adjustments for high-incident zones in East Oakland (CrimeIndex 1.11), West Oakland (CrimeIndex 1.10), and Downtown (CrimeIndex 1.10). Patrol allocation in these zones has been increased to match documented call volume and crime-index data, with deployment thresholds maintaining coverage across all districts. The adjustments are operational, data-driven, and in effect.
